No operator, website, or power capacity data appear in public sources. The location falls within range of Alicante-Elche Airport, but proximity alone does not indicate function.

Without business registration details or direct confirmation, it remains unclear whether this entry represents an actual data center, a misapplied tag on an unrelated business, or incomplete information.
